questions.question: Why did Naomi's family leave Bethlehem for Moab?
What did Ruth say when Naomi urged her to return to her own people?
options: "Let me stay and care for my own mother's house"
"I will return to my people once the famine ends"
"May the LORD watch between you and me while we are apart"
"Where you go I will go; your people will be my people"
questions.answer: "Where you go I will go; your people will be my people"

questions.question: Naomi's husband and both of her sons died in Moab.
Ruth told Naomi, "Your people will be my people, and your God my _____."
Naomi returned to _____ with Ruth at the start of the barley harvest.
